text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin dashed through her Debut race. 
Even after passing the goal post, the 
excitement wouldn't fade, her heart 
pounding with powerful, heavy thumps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin compared her racing heartbeat 
to the longing she had felt long ago for 
the "Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In that case, the goal is the Japanese 
Derby. To an outsider, it might look like 
a reckless endeavor. But her wish is my 
wish!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's bravely take on the GⅠ race where 
the strongest of the Junior Class gather. 
The next goal is set: the Asahi Hai FS!
